description: Run matrix of the 4680 thermal runaway propagation study (COMSOL Multiphysics 6.4, Battery Design Module). Every entry is transcribed from the project notes; nothing here was computed in this repository. Sources: section A = the author's project note ('4680 Thermal Runaway Propagation Project'), section B = the SHPE deep-dive section, CV = the resume entry (2026-10).

model.base: COMSOL Application Library 'Thermal Runaway Propagation in a Battery Pack' (Application ID 107571), Battery Design Module
model.pack: 20 cells, 5s4p, 2 mm gaps, acrylic holders, steel AISI 4340 connectors, air compartment, plastic wrapping (stock layout)
model.pulse: triangular, peak 36,667 W at t = 1 s, ends at 6 s
model.source: section A §3 model specification; section B step 4

swept_parameter.name: kT_batt_tl
swept_parameter.meaning: through-layer (radial, across the windings) thermal conductivity of the homogenised cell

contact_resistance_runs.description: Phase 1: cap contact resistance R_cap in h_eff = 1/(1/h_plate + R_cap) on the pack floor, h_plate = 2000, k_tl = 1.0 (stock)
contact_resistance_runs.result: a 100x change in R_cap moved the second ignition by about 0.3 min (about 20 s) out of about 23 min
contact_resistance_runs.diagnosis: boundary 23 is the pack enclosure floor, behind a few millimetres of acrylic holder (k about 0.19 W/m·K, about 5e-3 to 1e-2 m²·K/W), which is larger than the tabbed R_cap; h_eff is also capped by h_plate
contact_resistance_runs.source: section A §2 Phase 1; section B step 5

cascade_pace.method: kinks in pack-max and pack-average temperature probes, not per-cell probes; approximate
cascade_pace.source: section A §2 'Cascade pace'; section B step 9

exploration_on_stock_model.description: Day-1 runs on the stock pack (21 x 70 mm cells, 2.5 Ah, 32 kJ per the note), not the 4680 model
exploration_on_stock_model.source: section A §2 Phase 0; section B step 3
